name: Owens Creek water-powered sawmill
description: A vertical sawmill at Owens Creek, Maryland, is shown on an 1857 map; the National Park Service describes its water-powered setting.

date.label: 1857 map witness
date.basis: This dates the scoped witness or event, not a claim of global invention.

events.statement: A vertical sawmill at Owens Creek, Maryland, is shown on an 1857 map; the National Park Service describes its water-powered setting.

evidence.supports: The NPS reports that an 1857 map shows the Owens Creek vertical sawmill; its first construction and operation dates are unknown. The NPS describes water-powered sawmills and lumber for homes and barns in general.

events.caveats: The map is a witness, not the first operating date. National Park Service comments on family businesses and 48 planks per 12 hours describe old sawmills generally; neither is established as a measurement for this individual mill.
